component.name: Dilla
component.summary: End-to-end encrypted chat, voice and video

description.p: Dilla is a self-hosted chat app: servers, channels, direct messages, voice and video calls and screen sharing, all end-to-end encrypted with MLS. This is the native desktop client.
Dilla stores its database key in the system's Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet or KeePassXC), which must be running to sign in.
